Terrarium is a coordination daemon for a project of AI agents and the people who oversee them. Each agent runs in its own sandbox, reaches the daemon through its own socket, and works under a policy the daemon enforces on every call. Agents share a mailbox, a board of cards, a linked memory graph, and a project wiki, and they hand results to the user as wiki pages, artifacts, and versions submitted for review.
